1	/** Scoped Remote Event wiring and projection publishing for the browser question consumer. */
2	import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
3	import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
4	import { SlotRegistry } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client'
5	import { LocaleRuntime } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale/client'
6	import { createSnapshotStore } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store'
7	import type { InboxWireState } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/types'
8	import type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types'
9	import { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
10	import type { PendingUserQuestion, UserQuestionProjectionView } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/types'
11	import { QuestionComposer } from '../src/client/QuestionComposer.tsx'
12	import { PendingQuestion } from '../src/client/contract/slots.ts'
13	import { createQuestionDraftStore } from '../src/client/draft-store.ts'
14	import { apply, inject } from '../src/client/index.ts'
15	import { TimedQuestionWait } from '../../../interaction/user-questions/src/timed-wait.ts'
16	
17	const SESSION_ID = 'session-question' as SessionId
18	const SESSION_SCOPE = Symbol('question-session-scope')
19	const CALL = ToolCallId('call-timed')
20	const QUESTIONS = [{ id: 'mode', question: 'Choose a mode' }] as const
21	const ANSWER = { answers: [{ id: 'mode', selected: ['Fast'] }] }
22	const PLAN_QUESTIONS: PendingQuestion['questions'] = [{
23	  id: 'plan',
24	  question: 'Approve this plan?',
25	  detail: '# Plan',
26	  options: [{ label: 'Approve' }, { label: 'Keep planning' }],
27	  intent: { kind: 'plan-review', approve: 'Approve' },
28	}]
29	/** One settled call as its tool call row reads it back. */
30	const RECORD = { questions: [...QUESTIONS], answers: [...ANSWER.answers] }
31	const CONTINUED: PendingUserQuestion = { callId: CALL, questions: [...QUESTIONS], state: 'continued' }
32	/** The projection value this consumer reads; it acts on the answerable half alone. */
33	const view = (active: readonly PendingUserQuestion[]): UserQuestionProjectionView => ({ active, settled: [] })
34	const emptyInbox = (): InboxWireState => ({ 'next-step': [], 'next-turn': [] })
35	const queuedInbox = (callId: ToolCallId): InboxWireState => ({
36	  'next-step': [{ source: { kind: 'user-question-reply', callId }, content: [] }],
37	  'next-turn': [],
38	})
39	
40	type QuestionRequest = {
41	  questions: PendingQuestion['questions']
42	  signal?: AbortSignal
43	  wait?: { callId: ToolCallId; timed?: boolean }
44	}
45	type QuestionAnswer = typeof ANSWER
46	type QuestionNext = () => Promise<QuestionAnswer>
47	type QuestionListener = (
48	  this: Context,
49	  request: QuestionRequest,
50	  next: QuestionNext,
51	) => Promise<QuestionAnswer>
52	type RemoteBooleanResult = { ok: true; value: boolean } | { ok: false; error: { message: string } }
53	
54	/** `absent` seeds a projection face that has published nothing yet. */
55	async function bench(
56	  declare = true,
57	  durable: readonly PendingUserQuestion[] | 'absent' = [],
58	  remainingMs = 60_000,
59	  initialInbox: InboxWireState = emptyInbox(),
60	) {
61	  const ctx = new Context()
62	  await ctx.plugin(SlotRegistry).await()
63	  const slots = ctx.get('slots') as SlotRegistry
64	  if (declare) {
65	    slots.register(
66	      {
67	        name: 'root',
68	        children: {
69	          'conversation.composer': { kind: 'chain', scope: 'session' },
70	          'conversation.chat.node': { kind: 'keyed', scope: 'session' },
71	        },
72	      } as never,
73	      () => null,
74	    )
75	  }
76	  const locale = new LocaleRuntime(ctx)
77	  ctx.provide('locale', locale)
78	  const agent = ctx.extend({ [SESSION_SCOPE]: SESSION_ID })
79	  const scopeOf = vi.fn((candidate: Context) => (
80	    candidate as Context & { [SESSION_SCOPE]?: SessionId }
81	  )[SESSION_SCOPE])
82	  const projection = createSnapshotStore<UserQuestionProjectionView | undefined>(durable === 'absent' ? undefined : view(durable))
83	  const inbox = createSnapshotStore<InboxWireState | undefined>(initialInbox)
84	  const list = createSnapshotStore({
85	    ids: [SESSION_ID],
86	    byId: { [SESSION_ID]: { id: SESSION_ID } },
87	    phase: 'ready',
88	    subagentsByParent: {},
89	    jobsBySession: {},
90	    currentAddress: undefined,
91	  })
92	  const binding = vi.fn((sessionId: SessionId) => sessionId === SESSION_ID
93	    ? ({ sessionId: SESSION_ID, session: { projections: { faceOf: (name: string) => name === 'inbox' ? inbox : projection } } })
94	    : undefined)
95	  ctx.provide('sessions', { scopeOf, list, binding } as never)
96	  const pending = new Map<PendingQuestion, () => Promise<void>>()
97	  const registerPendingInteraction = vi.fn((_precedence: (value: PendingQuestion) => number) => (
98	    value: PendingQuestion,
99	    delegate: () => Promise<void>,
100	  ) => {
101	    _precedence(value)
102	    pending.set(value, delegate)
103	    return () => { pending.delete(value) }
104	  })
105	  ctx.provide('uiSession', { registerPendingInteraction } as never)
106	  const registerNode = vi.fn((_definition: { kind: string }) => () => {})
107	  ctx.provide('uiConversation', { events: { register: registerNode } } as never)
108	  let listener: QuestionListener | undefined
109	  const on = vi.fn((event: string, value: QuestionListener) => {
110	    expect(event).toBe('user-questions/request')
111	    listener = value
112	    return () => { listener = undefined }
113	  })
114	  const remoteQuestions = {
115	    attachWait: vi.fn((_sessionId: SessionId, _callId: ToolCallId, signal: AbortSignal) => {
116	      const ended = Promise.withResolvers<IteratorResult<{ remainingMs: number }>>()
117	      const dispose = (): void => {
118	        signal.removeEventListener('abort', dispose)
119	        ended.resolve({ done: true, value: undefined })
120	      }
121	      signal.addEventListener('abort', dispose, { once: true })
122	      let first = true
123	      return {
124	        dispose, send: () => {}, end: () => {},
125	        [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({
126	          next: () => {
127	            if (!first) return ended.promise
128	            first = false
129	            return Promise.resolve({ done: false as const, value: { remainingMs } })
130	          },
131	        }),
132	      }
133	    }),
134	    answer: vi.fn(async (
135	      _sessionId: SessionId, _callId: string, _answer: QuestionAnswer,
136	    ): Promise<RemoteBooleanResult> => ({ ok: true, value: true })),
137	  }
138	  ctx.provide('remote.userQuestions', remoteQuestions as never)
139	  ctx.provide('remote', { $on: on, userQuestions: remoteQuestions } as never)
140	  const fiber = ctx.plugin({ inject: [...inject], apply })
141	  await fiber.await()
142	  const invoke = (
143	    owner: Context,
144	    request: QuestionRequest,
145	    next: QuestionNext,
146	  ): Promise<QuestionAnswer> => {
147	    if (listener === undefined) throw new Error('question listener was not installed')
148	    return listener.call(owner, request, next)
149	  }
150	  return {
151	    ctx,
152	    slots,
153	    locale,
154	    agent,
155	    scopeOf,
156	    pending: { getSnapshot: () => [...pending.keys()] },
157	    /** The answer-panel provider this plugin fills for the tool call row. */
158	    panels: () => ctx.get('userQuestionPanels'),
159	    registerPendingInteraction,
160	    registerNode,
161	    on,
162	    fiber,
163	    list,
164	    binding,
165	    projection,
166	    inbox,
167	    remoteQuestions,
168	    invoke,
169	    async releasePending() {
170	      const delegates = [...pending.values()]
171	      pending.clear()
172	      await Promise.allSettled(delegates.map(delegate => delegate()))
173	    },
174	  }
175	}
176	
177	const timed = (): QuestionRequest => ({
178	  questions: QUESTIONS,
179	  wait: { callId: CALL, timed: true },
180	})
181	
182	describe('apply', () => {
183	  it('delegates an expired foreground wait and releases its claim stream', async () => {
184	    const b = await bench()
185	    const dispose = vi.fn()
186	    b.remoteQuestions.attachWait.mockImplementationOnce(() => ({
187	      dispose, send: () => {}, end: () => {},
188	      [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({
189	        next: () => Promise.resolve({ done: true as const, value: undefined }),
190	      }),
191	    }))
192	    try {
193	      const next = vi.fn(async () => ANSWER)
194	
195	      await expect(b.invoke(b.agent, timed(), next)).resolves.toBe(ANSWER)
196	
197	      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
198	      expect(dispose).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
199	      expect(b.remoteQuestions.attachWait.mock.calls[0]![2].aborted).toBe(true)
200	      expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]?.snapshot()).toMatchObject({ channel: 'none', countdown: undefined })
201	      b.projection.set(view([]))
202	      expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
203	    } finally {
204	      await b.fiber.dispose()
205	    }
206	  })
207	
208	  it('does not attach a cancelled claim after its first frame', async () => {
209	    const b = await bench(true, [CONTINUED])
210	    const controller = new AbortController()
211	    b.remoteQuestions.attachWait.mockImplementationOnce(() => ({
212	      dispose: vi.fn(), send: () => {}, end: () => {},
213	      [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({
214	        next: () => {
215	          controller.abort()
216	          return Promise.resolve({ done: false as const, value: { remainingMs: 60_000 } })
217	        },
218	      }),
219	    }))
220	    try {
221	      await expect(b.invoke(b.agent, { ...timed(), signal: controller.signal }, async () => ANSWER))
222	        .rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'ASK_ABORTED' })
223	      const card = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
224	      expect(card.snapshot()).toMatchObject({ state: 'continued', channel: 'rpc' })
225	      await card.answer(ANSWER)
226	      expect(b.remoteQuestions.answer).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
227	    } finally {
228	      await b.fiber.dispose()
229	    }
230	  })
231	
232	  it('keeps a timed card during a Session update before the claim first frame', async () => {
233	    const b = await bench()
234	    const opening = Promise.withResolvers<IteratorResult<{ remainingMs: number }>>()
235	    const ended = Promise.withResolvers<IteratorResult<{ remainingMs: number }>>()
236	    b.remoteQuestions.attachWait.mockImplementationOnce(() => {
237	      let reads = 0
238	      return {
239	        dispose: () => { ended.resolve({ done: true, value: undefined }) },
240	        send: () => {}, end: () => {},
241	        [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({ next: () => ++reads === 1 ? opening.promise : ended.promise }),
242	      }
243	    })
244	    try {
245	      const result = b.invoke(b.agent, timed(), async () => ANSWER)
246	      const card = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
247	      b.list.set({ ...b.list.getSnapshot() })
248	      expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toContain(card)
249	      expect(card.snapshot().closed).toBe(false)
250	
251	      opening.resolve({ done: false, value: { remainingMs: 60_000 } })
252	      await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(card.snapshot().channel).toBe('waterfall') })
253	      await card.answer(ANSWER)
254	      await expect(result).resolves.toEqual(ANSWER)
255	    } finally {
256	      opening.resolve({ done: true, value: undefined })
257	      await b.fiber.dispose()
258	    }
259	  })
260	
261	  it('attaches an indefinite request before publishing control back to the caller', async () => {
262	    const b = await bench()
263	    try {
264	      const result = b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS }, async () => ANSWER)
265	      expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]?.snapshot().channel).toBe('waterfall')
266	      await b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!.answer(ANSWER)
267	      await expect(result).resolves.toEqual(ANSWER)
268	    } finally {
269	      await b.fiber.dispose()
270	    }
271	  })
272	
273	  it('keeps a claim until the Host accepts an answer submitted after Take time', async () => {
274	    const b = await bench()
275	    vi.useFakeTimers()
276	    const wait = new TimedQuestionWait(Date.now() + 5_000, undefined, new Error('unclaimed timeout'))
277	    const claimed = Promise.withResolvers<undefined>()
278	    const released = Promise.withResolvers<undefined>()
279	    const dispose = vi.fn(() => { released.resolve(undefined) })
280	    b.remoteQuestions.attachWait.mockImplementationOnce((_sessionId, _callId, signal) => {
281	      const iterator = wait.attach(signal)[Symbol.asyncIterator]()
282	      let reads = 0
283	      return {
284	        dispose, send: () => {}, end: () => {},
285	        [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({
286	          next: () => {
287	            const result = iterator.next()
288	            if (++reads === 2) claimed.resolve(undefined)
289	            return result
290	          },
291	        }),
292	      }
293	    })
294	    try {
295	      const result = b.invoke(b.agent, timed(), async () => ANSWER)
296	      await claimed.promise
297	      const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
298	      pending.takeTime()
299	      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(6_000)
300	      await pending.answer(ANSWER)
301	      await expect(result).resolves.toEqual(ANSWER)
302	
303	      // The event carrier sends the answer only after its Client listener returns.
304	      // Keep delivery withheld while the original deadline is already past.
305	      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1_000)
306	      expect(wait.signal.aborted).toBe(false)
307	      expect(dispose).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
308	
309	      wait.close(new Error('Host accepted the answer'))
310	      await released.promise
311	      expect(dispose).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
312	      expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
313	    } finally {
314	      wait.close(new Error('test ended'))
315	      await b.fiber.dispose()
316	      vi.useRealTimers()
317	    }
318	  })
319	
320	  it('declares the services it binds', () => {
321	    expect(inject).toEqual(['sessions', 'remote', 'remote.userQuestions', 'uiSession', 'slots', 'locale', 'uiConversation'])
322	  })
323	
324	  it('installs the Remote Event listener and delegates an unscoped request', async () => {
325	    const b = await bench(false)
326	    const next = vi.fn(async () => ANSWER)
327	
328	    await expect(b.invoke(b.ctx, { questions: QUESTIONS }, next)).resolves.toBe(ANSWER)
329	
330	    expect(b.on).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
331	    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
332	    expect(b.slots.entries('conversation.composer')).toHaveLength(0)
333	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
334	  })
335	
336	  it('registers the late-reply conversation node with the conversation runtime', async () => {
337	    const b = await bench()
338	
339	    expect(b.registerNode).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
340	    expect(b.registerNode.mock.calls[0]![0]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'user-question-reply', target: 'chat' })
341	    expect(b.slots.entries('conversation.chat.node').map(entry => entry.options.key)).toEqual(['question-reply'])
342	  })
343	
344	  it('follows only bound Sessions and drops a projection subscription with its Session', async () => {
345	    const b = await bench(true, 'absent')
346	    const other = 'session-unbound' as SessionId
347	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
348	
349	    b.list.set({ ...b.list.getSnapshot(), ids: [SESSION_ID, other], byId: { [SESSION_ID]: { id: SESSION_ID }, [other]: { id: other } } })
350	    expect(b.binding).toHaveBeenCalledWith(other)
351	    b.projection.set(view([CONTINUED]))
352	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot().map(card => card.key)).toEqual([`question:${SESSION_ID}:${CALL}`])
353	
354	    // Unbinding the Session removes its cards and stops following its projection.
355	    b.list.set({ ...b.list.getSnapshot(), ids: [other], byId: { [other]: { id: other } } })
356	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
357	    b.projection.set(view([{ ...CONTINUED, callId: ToolCallId('call-after-unbind') }]))
358	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
359	  })
360	
361	  it('projects a scoped request through one stable composer and returns its answer', async () => {
362	    const b = await bench()
363	    const next = vi.fn(async () => ANSWER)
364	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS }, next)
365	    await Promise.resolve()
366	
367	    const entry = b.slots.entries('conversation.composer')[0]!
368	    expect(entry.component).toBe(QuestionComposer)
369	    expect(entry.locale).toBe('question')
370	    const store = entry.store as ReturnType<typeof createQuestionDraftStore>
371	    expect(store.create(SESSION_ID).getSnapshot()).toEqual({ progressByRequest: {} })
372	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
373	    const face = (entry.inject as () => { keyedHooks: { questionCard: (key: string) => PendingQuestion | undefined } })()
374	    expect(face.keyedHooks.questionCard(pending.key)).toBe(pending)
375	    expect(face.keyedHooks.questionCard('question:missing')).toBeUndefined()
376	    const select = entry.select as (
377	      owner: { pendingInteraction: PendingQuestion | undefined },
378	    ) => PendingQuestion | null
379	    expect(select({ pendingInteraction: undefined })).toBeNull()
380	    expect(select({ pendingInteraction: pending })).toBe(pending)
381	    expect(pending).toMatchObject({ kind: 'question', sessionId: SESSION_ID, questions: QUESTIONS, callId: undefined })
382	    expect(pending.snapshot()).toEqual({
383	      state: 'open', waitState: 'counting', countdown: undefined,
384	      channel: 'waterfall', closed: false,
385	    })
386	
387	    await pending.answer(ANSWER)
388	    await expect(result).resolves.toBe(ANSWER)
389	    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
390	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
391	    expect(b.slots.entries('conversation.composer')).toHaveLength(1)
392	  })

394	  it('a request the Host never named ends with ASK_CANCELLED when the user closes its panel', async () => {
395	    const b = await bench()
396	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS }, async () => ANSWER)
397	    await Promise.resolve()
398	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
399	    expect(pending.dismissal).toBe('cancel')
400	    const rejection = expect(result).rejects.toMatchObject({
401	      name: 'UserQuestionError',
402	      code: 'ASK_CANCELLED',
403	      message: 'the user cancelled ask_user_question',
404	    })
405	
406	    await pending.dismiss()
407	    await rejection
408	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
409	  })

411	  it('removes an aborted blocking request while preserving the stable composer', async () => {
412	    const b = await bench()
413	    const controller = new AbortController()
414	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS, signal: controller.signal }, async () => ANSWER)
415	    await Promise.resolve()
416	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toHaveLength(1)
417	
418	    controller.abort()
419	
420	    await expect(result).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'ASK_ABORTED' })
421	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
422	    expect(b.slots.entries('conversation.composer')).toHaveLength(1)
423	  })

425	  it('delegates an active request when its interaction domain unloads, and settles the release only once the listener has handed it on', async () => {
426	    const b = await bench()
427	    const handedOn = Promise.withResolvers<typeof ANSWER>()
428	    const next = vi.fn(() => handedOn.promise)
429	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS }, next)
430	    await Promise.resolve()
431	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toHaveLength(1)
432	
433	    let released = false
434	    const release = b.releasePending().then(() => { released = true })
435	    await Promise.resolve()
436	    await Promise.resolve()
437	    // The registry's release awaits the listener's `next()`, exactly as the
438	    // blocking question always did, so a plugin teardown never resolves ahead
439	    // of the request it is handing back.
440	    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
441	    expect(released).toBe(false)
442	
443	    handedOn.resolve(ANSWER)
444	    await release
445	
446	    expect(released).toBe(true)
447	    await expect(result).resolves.toBe(ANSWER)
448	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
449	  })
450	
451	  it('keys a timed request by Session and call and settles it with ASK_TIMED_OUT at the local deadline', async () => {
452	    const b = await bench()
453	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, timed(), async () => ANSWER)
454	    await Promise.resolve()
455	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
456	    expect(pending.key).toBe(`question:${SESSION_ID}:${CALL}`)
457	    expect(pending.dismissal).toBe('hide')
458	    expect(pending.snapshot()).toMatchObject({
459	      state: 'open', waitState: 'counting', channel: 'waterfall', closed: false,
460	    })
461	    // The card owns the countdown, so it reads the deadline down from now.
462	    expect(pending.snapshot().countdown).toEqual({ remainingMs: expect.any(Number) as number, running: true })
463	    expect(pending.snapshot().countdown!.remainingMs).toBeGreaterThan(55_000)
464	    const rejection = expect(result).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'UserQuestionError', code: 'ASK_TIMED_OUT' })
465	
466	    pending.timeout()
467	
468	    await rejection
469	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([pending])
470	    expect(pending.snapshot()).toEqual({
471	      state: 'open', waitState: 'counting', countdown: undefined,
472	      channel: 'none', closed: false,
473	    })
474	    await expect(pending.answer(ANSWER)).rejects.toThrow(/no channel/)
475	  })
476	
477	  it('anchors a Host-measured remaining wait to the Client clock', async () => {
478	    const b = await bench(true, [], 2_000)
479	    const request = timed()
480	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, request, async () => ANSWER)
481	    await Promise.resolve()
482	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
483	    expect(pending.snapshot().countdown!.remainingMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2_000)
484	    expect(pending.snapshot().countdown!.remainingMs).toBeGreaterThan(1_000)

489	  it('a card-keyed request without a deadline waits with no countdown', async () => {
490	    const b = await bench()
491	    // Nothing settles an indefinite wait, so the request stays pending past this test.
492	    void b.invoke(b.agent, { questions: QUESTIONS, wait: { callId: CALL } }, async () => ANSWER)
493	    await Promise.resolve()
494	
495	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
496	    expect(pending.key).toBe(`question:${SESSION_ID}:${CALL}`)
497	    expect(pending.dismissal).toBe('hide')
498	    expect(pending.snapshot()).toEqual({
499	      state: 'open', waitState: 'counting', countdown: undefined,
500	      channel: 'waterfall', closed: false,
501	    })
502	  })

504	  it('closing a card-keyed panel only leaves the seat, and the panel provider brings it back', async () => {
505	    const b = await bench()
506	    const next = vi.fn(async () => ANSWER)
507	    const result = b.invoke(b.agent, timed(), next)
508	    await Promise.resolve()
509	    const pending = b.pending.getSnapshot()[0]!
510	
511	    await pending.dismiss()
512	
513	    // Nothing settled: the tool call still waits, and its countdown still runs.
514	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([])
515	    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
516	    expect(pending.snapshot()).toMatchObject({ channel: 'waterfall', closed: false })
517	
518	    expect(b.panels()?.reveal(SESSION_ID, CALL)).toBe(true)
519	    expect(b.pending.getSnapshot()).toEqual([pending])
520	
521	    await pending.answer(ANSWER)
522	    await expect(result).resolves.toBe(ANSWER)
